name: Hyperspeed
author: E. T. Carter
description: The jump to lightspeed from the cockpit: stars pour out of a dim glowing core and stretch into motion-blurred streaks that lengthen toward the frame edges, three parallax layers of them at different speeds. Each streak carries a white-hot head trailing off into a palette tint, and the haze beneath them is smeared radially too, so the whole frame streams outward while the tunnel rolls slowly about its axis.

params.label: Warp speed
params.effect: How fast the stars stream outward and the haze scrolls; 0 freezes the jump mid-frame.

params.label: Star density
params.effect: Fraction of lattice slots that hold a star; low is a sparse handful of streaks, 1 is a full downpour.

params.label: Streak length
params.effect: Length of the motion-blur trails; low is short sparks, high draws blades that span the frame.

params.label: Core glow
params.effect: Brightness of the core lamp and the radial haze; 0 is stars on near-black, high is a bright tunnel.

params.label: Trail tint
params.effect: How strongly the trails take palette colour behind their white heads; 0 is pure white streaks.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer steers the vanishing point; 0 ignores the mouse.
